title: Eastern Illinois volleyball picked fourth in OVC preseason poll
text:
Eastern Illinois volleyball picked fourth in OVC preseason poll
K. R. Stuart
Eastern Illinois volleyball was selected to finish fourth in the Ohio Valley Conference preseason poll, the league announced on Aug. 19. The Panthers, who are the reigning regular season and tournament OVC champions, aim to repeat their success and secure a fifth regular season title.
Morehead State, which shared the 2025 OVC regular season championship with Eastern Illinois, was chosen as the preseason favorite. Southeast Missouri and Southern Indiana were ranked second and third, respectively. Following Eastern Illinois in the poll are Lindenwood at fifth place and SIUE at sixth. UT Martin, Western Illinois, and Tennessee State round out seventh through ninth places.
The Panthers return two All-OVC players from last year's squad: Katie Kopshever and Ariadna Pereles. Kopshever earned first team All-OVC honors after recording 326 kills (3.02 per set) and 261 digs (2.42 per set), achieving double-digit kills in 21 matches along with 11 double-doubles. She finished ninth in both kills per set and points per set within the conference last year.
Pereles made second team All-OVC after ranking sixteenth nationally—and second in the conference—for digs per set at 4.99 during her sophomore campaign. She led Eastern Illinois with 563 digs while also contributing 110 assists for the season. Pereles received two OVC Defensive Player of the Week awards last year.
Two additional Panthers have been named to watch lists for this upcoming season: sophomore opposite hitter Jorah Rutter—who appeared in seven matches as a freshman—and senior setter Hannah Hawkins, a transfer from Wichita State who previously played three seasons at High Point University, where she contributed to three consecutive Big South championships.
Eastern Illinois will open its 2026 campaign at the Dayton/Wright State Classic starting August 28.
